children: Greek industrial output declined by 1.2% year-on-year in July, after an upwardly revised 1.2% increase in June, data from statistics service ELSTAT showed on Thursday.
A breakdown of index components showed manufacturing production rose 1.9% from the same month in 2025. Electricity output was down by 12.4% year-on-year, and mining production was down by 3.5%.

Compared to the same month a year earlier, in July the greatest percentage increase was recorded in mining of coal and lignite, while the highest percentage decrease was recorded in the motor vehicles, trailers and semi-trailers divisionn ELSTAT said.
